Socialization means positive exposures in the first 16 weeks shape temperament Crate training means the safe den, never a punishment Together these ideas give the learner working intuition, not just vocabulary. The Signature presentation stresses why each principle holds, shows where it is used in real practice, and connects it forward to the Advanced material that follows.
